Noise-free data at 10⁶ counts. Reached: starts ending within Δχ² ≤ 4 of the truth. Modes: groups of those endpoints (registered rule 2); Δχ² of each mode's best endpoint. Labels per film parameter (d, ρ; layer 2 after the slash). Competitor: the lowest endpoint above Δχ² 4 distinct from every mode, and s*, the counting level at which it would be within Δχ² 1 (not part of the registered decision). At cap: fits of the 64 that stopped at the 200-evaluation limit. Not reached: no start ended within Δχ² ≤ 4, so the condition has no mode and no label (amendment 7); it is evidence neither for nor against multimodality. In brackets, the width labels of a local fit from the truth: post hoc, outside the decision, and blind to multimodality because it only sees the truth's basin (not run in R2a, so no brackets appear). Not analysed: fitted, but `analyze` was not run for the condition.
